summary: Iteration 15: Tested SuperAdmin Dashboard (GET /api/superadmin/dashboard + /admin/dashboard page). 10/10 backend pytest PASS - validated structure, totals, companies_by_plan, estimated_revenue, revenue_by_plan, 6-month patient_growth, companies_at_limit, recent_plan_changes, 403 for non-superadmin, 401/403 for unauthenticated. Frontend: 4 KPI cards render with correct values (4 opticas, 20 pacientes, 10 usuarios, Q599 revenue), pie chart 'Opticas por Plan' visible, bar chart 'Crecimiento de Pacientes (6 meses)' visible, horizontal bar 'Revenue Estimado por Plan' visible, 2 companies-at-limit alerts shown (Optica Vision Clara 300%, Demo 100%), 4 recent plan change timeline entries with old->new badges, SuperAdmin /dashboard correctly redirects to /admin/dashboard, sidebar shows Dashboard as first item. All flows working end-to-end.

minor.issue: patient_growth uses 30-day fixed intervals (now - i*30 days) instead of calendar months. This causes month boundary drift across the 6 buckets (e.g., 'Apr 2026' bucket starts at YYYY-MM-01 of current month but the next bucket boundary uses month_str+30days which can map to same month). For current data it works, but the bucketing is not strictly monthly and may double-count or skip days in long runs.

patient_growth created_at filter is a string compare ('YYYY-MM-DD' lex order). Works only because patients store created_at as ISO-8601 strings. If created_at is later changed to datetime objects, this query will silently return 0.

issues: Pie chart label 'Free (3)' is rendered very close to the card edge and may clip on narrower viewports; consider increasing chart container padding or reducing outerRadius. Visual polish only.

frontend: +3 este mes badge on companies KPI
Companies at limit section with 2 limit-alert-* entries (Vision Clara 300% red, Demo 100% red)
Recent plan changes section with 4 recent-change-* timeline entries
Sidebar first nav item is 'Dashboard' for superadmin

action_items: [INFO] Enterprise plan price is Q599 (not Q799 as mentioned in problem statement). The previous testing iteration reportedly modified the Enterprise plan price; if Q799 is intended, main agent should update plans.price for Enterprise.
[OPTIONAL] Improve patient_growth bucketing to use calendar month boundaries instead of 30-day intervals (cosmetic, but more accurate over time).
[OPTIONAL] Consider keying patient created_at filter by datetime if/when patient model changes.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/superadmin.py: patient_growth uses 30-day arithmetic and string-comparison on created_at. Works today but fragile if created_at type changes or month spans 31 days. Consider using calendar.monthrange + ISODate.
/app/backend/routes/superadmin.py: companies_by_plan dict iteration order is dict-insertion order; final filter '>0' is fine but UI legend ordering depends on plan list order from DB.

/app/frontend/src/pages/SuperAdminDashboard.js line 22: api.get(...).catch(()=>{}) silently swallows errors. Consider showing an error state instead of an indefinite empty/loading screen if the API 500s.
/app/frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.js: superadmin redirect happens inside useEffect after an initial render of the loading spinner; minor flicker. Acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SuperAdmin Dashboard endpoint /api/superadmin/dashboard returns: totals{companies,patients,users,branches}, companies_by_plan[{name,value}], estimated_revenue (number), revenue_by_plan[{name,value}], patient_growth[6]{month,count}, companies_at_limit[{name,plan_name,patients,max_patients,branches,max_branches,patients_warning,branches_warning,patients_percent,branches_percent}], recent_plan_changes[<=10], new_companies_month. 403 for non-superadmin. SuperAdmin redirect from /dashboard to /admin/dashboard implemented in DashboardPage.js useEffect.
